name: vet402 copy-guard gate
description: Pay 0.01 USDG over x402 and have a Chainlink CRE workflow re-verify a wallet's anchored vet402 /rwa record against Robinhood Chain. The answer is MATCH or MISMATCH with one reason bit per failed check. A compliance check an autonomous agent can run before it acts on a tokenized-stock record.

authentication.note: No account and no API key. A payment proves that a payment authorization was supplied. It does not identify the caller.

skills.name: Re-verify a vet402 /rwa record against its onchain anchor
skills.description: Runs the Chainlink CRE workflow vet402-rwa-verify: reads the anchored record, recomputes its hash, reads the anchor from RwaAnchor on Robinhood Chain (4663) and returns MATCH or MISMATCH. When the gate is started with --broadcast the verdict is also written to RwaVerdictReceiver on Robinhood Testnet (46630).

examples.output: MATCH for the demo wallet's anchor 0x15f9ed8a…585c7f

limits.execution: cre workflow simulate, started by the gate. Nothing is deployed to a DON.
limits.attestation: None. Simulated runs write through CRE's simulation forwarder, which accepts reports from anyone.
limits.advice: The answer says whether a record matches its anchor. It is not legal or investment advice.
